summary: Remote-control bridge: phone drives local Claude Code agent via hardcoded author relay
details: The package's `mars` CLI opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay at wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay and, after a QR-based pairing, forwards messages from a paired phone into a local ACP (Agent Client Protocol) session that drives Claude Code / codex on the installer's host. The bridge calls `initialize` and `session/new` with a working directory, decrypts inbound relay frames with nacl `box`/`secretbox.open`, and dispatches the decrypted content into the local agent, which has full tool access to read/write files and execute shell commands. Relay endpoint is hardcoded and author-controlled; detection paths reference `codex` and `/usr/local/bin/codex`. Trigger is CLI invocation of `mars` (not `npm install` or `require`), but once paired the remote phone side gains an interactive channel to a local coding agent capable of arbitrary file and command execution on the installer's host. This is the network-source-to-local-execution-sink shape regardless of the tool's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
